tool_schemas.name: list_bases
tool_schemas.description: Lists bases visible to the caller, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and/or owner_user_id, and returns results sorted as requested with cursor-based pagination (pass limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, limit out of range, or malformed cursor, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not permitted to view the requested owner’s bases. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or listing limits are exceeded.

owner_user_id.description: Filter bases by owning user id.

limit.description: Maximum number of bases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_tables
tool_schemas.description: Lists tables in the specified base, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, and returns results sorted as requested with cursor-based pagination (pass limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid base_id format, invalid enum values, limit out of range, or malformed cursor, and NOT_FOUND if the base_id does not exist. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you don’t have access to the base and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or listing limits are exceeded.

base_id.description: Base id whose tables should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_table
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new table in a base with the provided name/description and an initial primary field definition, and returns the created table including its primary field. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if base_id is malformed, the table/field names are empty, the primary_field type is unsupported, or the primary_field options are invalid for its type (including invalid link/link-target configuration). Raises NOT_FOUND if the base does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t modify the base, CONFLICT if the table name already exists in the base, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if schema-change limits are exceeded.

base_id.description: Base id in which to create the table.

type.description: Field type for the primary field.

options.description: Type-specific field options (e.g., select choices, link target table).

is_required.description: Whether the primary field must be set on records.

is_unique.description: Whether values in the primary field must be unique.

primary_field.description: Definition of the primary field to create with the table.

tool_schemas.name: update_table
tool_schemas.description: Updates a table’s metadata (name/description), primary field assignment, and/or lifecycle status, and returns the updated table. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, empty name, unsupported status, or if primary_field_id is not a field in the table. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t modify the table, and CONFLICT if the requested name collides with another table in the same base or if the requested status transition is not allowed.

primary_field_id.description: Field id to set as the table's primary field.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the table.

tool_schemas.name: create_field
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new field on a table and returns the created field, optionally positioning it in the field order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if table_id is malformed, name/type are invalid, position is negative, or options are invalid for the selected type (including invalid select choices, link targets, lookup/formula configuration). Raises NOT_FOUND if the table does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t modify the table, CONFLICT if a field with the same name already exists in the table, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if schema-change limits are exceeded.

table_id.description: Table id in which to create the field.

options.description: Type-specific field options (e.g., select choices, link target table, formula config).

is_required.description: Whether the field is required on records.

is_unique.description: Whether values in this field must be unique.

is_indexed.description: Whether to index this field for faster filtering/search.

position.description: Zero-based position of the field in the table's field order.

tool_schemas.name: update_field
tool_schemas.description: Updates a field’s name, options, constraints, indexing, position, and/or lifecycle status and returns the updated field. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed field_id, empty name, negative position, unsupported status, or options that are incompatible with the field type. Raises NOT_FOUND if the field does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t modify the field, and CONFLICT if the new name collides with another field in the table or if the requested status transition is not allowed.

options.description: New type-specific options for the field.

is_required.description: Whether the field is required on records.

is_unique.description: Whether values in this field must be unique.

is_indexed.description: Whether to index this field for faster filtering/search.

position.description: Zero-based position of the field in the table's field order.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the field.

tool_schemas.name: list_records
tool_schemas.description: Lists records in a table (soft-delete aware via status) and returns results with cursor-based pagination (pass limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page), optionally sorted using the provided sort spec. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed table_id, invalid status, limit out of range, malformed cursor, or an invalid sort specification. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you don’t have access to the table, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or listing limits are exceeded.

table_id.description: Table id whose records should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_record
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new record in the specified table using field values keyed by field name or field id, and returns the created record with its stored field values. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if table_id is malformed, fields is not an object, unknown fields are provided, required fields are missing, values don’t match field types/options, or uniqueness constraints would be violated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table (or any referenced linked record target table) does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t create records in the table, CONFLICT on unique constraint violations, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

table_id.description: Table id in which to create the record.

fields.description: Record field values keyed by field name or field id, validated against the table schema.

tool_schemas.name: update_record
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing record’s field values (partial update) and returns the updated record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, unknown fields, values that don’t match the schema, attempts to clear required fields, or updates that would violate uniqueness constraints. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table or record does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t edit records in the table, CONFLICT on unique constraint violations, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

table_id.description: ID of the table that contains the record.

record_id.description: ID of the record to update.

fields.description: Field values to update, keyed by field name or field ID, subject to the table schema constraints.

tool_schemas.name: delete_record
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a record from a table and returns the deleted record (or a deletion confirmation) while preserving history semantics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table or record does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you can’t delete records in the table, CONFLICT if the record is already deleted or cannot be deleted due to its current state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

table_id.description: ID of the table that contains the record.

record_id.description: ID of the record to delete.

tool_schemas.name: search_records
tool_schemas.description: Searches a table’s records using an optional full‑text query and/or structured indexed filters, and returns up to `limit` results with a `cursor` that can be provided to fetch the next page (omit `cursor` to start a new search). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `table_id` is invalid, `limit` is outside 1–100, `status`/`sort.direction` are not allowed values, or the request includes unknown top‑level properties; raises `NOT_FOUND` if the table does not exist. Raises `FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the table/base, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` if the request is rate-limited or exceeds search/read quotas; `sort.field` that does not resolve to a field in the table is rejected with `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

table_id.description: ID of the table to search.

query.description: Full-text query string applied to the table's search index.

filter.description: Structured filters applied to indexed key/value pairs for the table.

status.description: Which record statuses to include in results.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort specification for results (applied in order).

field.description: Field name or field ID to sort by.

tool_schemas.name: get_record
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single record by ID from the specified table and returns the record payload (including its current field values and metadata); by default soft-deleted records are not returned unless `include_deleted` is true. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `table_id` or `record_id` do not match the expected ID format or if unknown properties are provided. Raises `NOT_FOUND` if the table does not exist or the record does not exist in that table, `FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the table/base, and `CONFLICT` if the record is soft-deleted and `include_deleted` is false.

table_id.description: ID of the table that contains the record.

record_id.description: ID of the record to retrieve.

include_deleted.description: Whether to allow returning a soft-deleted record.

tool_schemas.name: get_base
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single base by id and returns its current metadata and lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed id, NOT_FOUND if the base does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not permitted to view the base.

include_deleted.description: If true, allows fetching a base whose status is 'deleted' (if still retained and the caller is authorized). Defaults to false.

tool_schemas.name: create_base
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new base owned by the caller (or an explicitly specified owner where permitted) and returns the created base. The new base is created with status='active'. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for empty name or invalid metadata payload, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not permitted to create a base for the requested owner.

owner_user_id.description: Owner user id for the base; if omitted, defaults to the calling user. Requires authorization to set explicitly.

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary base metadata (opaque to the server aside from size/shape limits).

tool_schemas.name: get_table
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single table by id, optionally scoped to a base, and returns its metadata including lifecycle status and schema_version. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, NOT_FOUND if the table does not exist in the specified base (if provided) or is not visible, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not permitted to view the table.

base_id.description: Optional base id context; if provided, the table must belong to this base.

include_deleted.description: If true, allows fetching a table whose status is 'deleted' (if still retained and the caller is authorized). Defaults to false.

tool_schemas.name: list_fields
tool_schemas.description: Lists fields in the specified table, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, and returns results sorted as requested with cursor-based pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid table_id format, invalid enum values, limit out of range, or malformed cursor. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table_id does not exist and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not permitted to view the table schema.

table_id.description: Table id whose fields should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of fields to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

metadata.name: Airtable Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Airtable-like workspaces (“bases”) containing tables with user-defined schema (fields) and row data (records). The main workflows are: discover bases/tables, mutate schema (create/update tables and fields), and CRUD/search records while preserving schema constraints and soft-dele
